description: §6.7.1a — a multi-statement `on mount { }` body containing a `match` statement lowers through the real statement codegen. `@x = 2` then `match @x { 2 -> {...} _ -> {...} }` — pre-fix the multi-statement body fell to the string rewriter, which cannot lower `match` (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC). Post-fix both statements run at mount: @x = 2, the match selects the `2` arm and writes @label = "two". A single-statement `match` mount body already compiled (fast-path) and is unchanged; this pins the multi-statement case that rode along on the fix. No input — the boot/mount shape.
rationale: §6.7.1a sugar-equivalence — a `match` statement inside `on mount` lowers exactly as inside a `function` body. With @x set to 2, the match dispatches the literal-2 arm, writing @label = "two"; the wildcard arm is not taken.
